title: Let the search cool in saintly company
summary: The shabad names the exhaustion of forests, philosophies, rituals, postures, and repeated rising without peace. Let the search cool where mercy brings holy company.
takeaway: Bring the search to the company where mind and body can cool.
lifeApplication: Before changing methods again, choose one steady place of sangat or Bani and let the restless body remain there without bargaining.

source.shortMeaning: Restless searching cools only when mercy brings the seeker into holy company.
source.lifeApplication: Before changing methods again, stay with one true company long enough for the body to cool.

evidence.coreClaim: Restless searching cools only when mercy brings the seeker into holy company.
evidence.turn: The shabad exhausts spiritual roaming and then lets mercy, sangat, and patience become the place of arrival.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before changing methods again, choose one steady place of sangat or Bani and let the restless body remain there without bargaining.
